description: Resolve a named company group (e.g. "FAANG", "AI", "Fintech") into its list of company slugs, for use in the benchmark tools' companySlugs filter. Matching is case- and separator-insensitive. Omit "group" (or pass an unknown one) to get the list of available group names. Available groups: FAANG, AUTOMOTIVE, SPACE, SOCIAL_MEDIA, AI, AI_PLUS, FINTECH, FAANG_PLUS, HEDGE_FUNDS, SEMICONDUCTOR, BIOTECH, WEB3, TRADING_FIRMS, DEFENSE.

group.description: Company group name to resolve (e.g. "FAANG", "AI", "Fintech"). Case/separator-insensitive. Omit to list all available groups.

name: get-company-group
